collected_and_inspected: All four native solver logs, stderr, timing trajectories, Cd trajectories, iteration counts, commands, runtime/library seals, source/copy/field seals, GNU time and before/after node CPU snapshots.
not_collected: Sustained hardware frequency, cycles, memory/network bandwidth, NUMA page residency, actual solver helper-thread affinity.
limitations: One 40-step ABBA allocation, not a scored 150-step four-node run.
Organizer arms have only 39 intervals versus native sample recommendations 45 and 56.
Temporal drift remains; directionally consistent adjacent comparisons do not establish an isolated I/O or binding cause.
Teammate treatment and organizer control share the same initialized Scotch case; this is a solver-stage runtime comparison, not a replay of the teammate full preparation pipeline.
GNU time command maximum RSS is not summed node memory; CPU time may include MPI busy waiting.
assessment: Teammate runtime recipe has a directionally consistent favorable signal (-12.45% and -10.18%, pooled -11.22%) against organizer runtime on this Iris screen, but large repeats (+17.92% organizer, +20.97% teammate) and insufficient organizer sample recommendations limit confidence. This is not our own configuration win or a Gadi/NSCC score.
